concerns.text: T006b hardcodes only OQMD and AFLOW sources. FR-001 and US-1 explicitly mandate conditional ingestion of Materials Project if a verified API key exists. The task lacks the logic to attempt MP ingestion or fallback gracefully, silently weakening the functional requirement.

T036 defines a static linear weight vector for the synthetic ground truth. FR-014 and SC-003 explicitly require a 'non-linear' feature weight distribution to validate SHAP distortion. A linear vector fails to test the non-linear distortion hypothesis, violating the research constraint.

T008 describes calculating the ImbalanceScore but omits the explicit implementation step for K-Means clustering (k=50) required to derive the cluster assignments for the Gini coefficient calculation per FR-002. This risks an implementation gap where the metric cannot be computed as specified.

T006c depends on T006b (data download) to generate checksums. Since T006b is incomplete (missing MP logic), T006c cannot fully satisfy Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) regarding checksumming all required artifacts. This creates a circular dependency where the validation task is blocked by an incomplete prerequisite.
